description: Get estimated costs for your infrastructure

env.help: Your Infracost API key, read by the Infracost CLI. The hook stops before estimating if it is unset.
env.name: INFRACOST_API_KEY

flags.help: The Infracost CLI version the hook installs.
flags.name: cli-version

flags.help: A monthly amount. A warning is shown when the new total exceeds it, unless the change lowers your cost.
flags.name: warn-total-cost-above-amount

flags.help: A monthly amount. A warning is shown when the total change exceeds it.
flags.name: warn-total-change-above-amount

flags.help: A percentage increase. A warning is shown when the new total exceeds the previous total by more than this.
flags.name: warn-total-change-above-percent

flags.help: A monthly amount. The hook blocks merge when the new total exceeds it, unless the change lowers your cost.
flags.name: deny-total-cost-above-amount

flags.help: A monthly amount. The hook blocks merge when the total change exceeds it.
flags.name: deny-total-change-above-amount

flags.help: A percentage increase. The hook blocks merge when the new total exceeds the previous total by more than this.
flags.name: deny-total-change-above-percent

flags.help: Log verbosity. A more verbose PIPELINES_LOG_LEVEL overrides it. One of: trace,debug,info,warning,error,fatal,panic.
flags.name: log-level

name: infracost
title: Infracost
